notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
While everyone else is polishing their mammoths for the Ukrainian Games Festival 2025, we’ve been busy hammering bugs and teaching bosses some manners. Here’s what’s new in this prehistoric upgrade: 

Feline Logic Restored,

Fashion stays after dying,

Boss Behavior Upgrade,

Punchier Combat Feel,

Multi OS, game now available on Mac & Linux,

 This patch is part of our celebration for Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 — a great excuse to update the game, squash some mammoth-sized bugs, and party like it’s 12,000 BC!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2.1
notes.content:
A few sneaky bugs got quietly squashed:

- Ugh cannot be controlled while the Weapon/Clothes Selector is open right after the loading screen

- Special Range attack is attacking specially again

- The exploit with Spacesuit’s effects was removed

- A bunch of NullReferenceExceptions were fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311988/0b50f9d73bb3b4b7c03c52bd5be908b20ff1a814.png"]

Welcome to Patch 1.2.0, where Ugr snores (but only once), pigs respect death, and swimming platforms finally stop launching into low orbit. We've cleaned up some dusty corners of the desert, taught our Nomad Leader some boundaries (and gave his push a proper punch), and finally made sure that if something looks dangerous - it actually is. From hippos behaving as intended to enemy AI learning a bit of humility, this update is packed with juicy fixes and subtle polish to make your journey smoother, bloodier, and slightly less cursed.



Full changelog below - grab your tambourine (only after the right quest, of course) and dive in:

The Hippo boss damages the player as expected 

Pikeman's damage collider reduction (no more false hits)

Blood splatters added to notify about the stakes below

Now you can climb onto the Desert landing pad

The symbol of animals better reflects the objective of the Circus master

Ugr snores only once at the beginning of the game

Ugr's cave symbol on the wooden sign was changed

The Tambourine and the Rhi's Crown won't shine before the quests, during which we can pick them

Corrupted worm nest SFX fix

Smashable enemies won't damage you right after you land on them

Swimming platforms won’t fly away if you hit them underneath

Checkpoints can be activated again after you get new quests, new items (quest, weapon, clothes), and easter eggs

Flying enemies won't be stuck in the attack animation on a player's death

Enemies won’t respawn in front of the player

Movement controlled by the gamepad stick was improved

Resource quantity is displayed in the craft menus

The Pig won’t disappear after the player’s respawn

The Nomad Leader won’t go out of bounds

The Nomad Leader pushes will deal damage

Quest question mark will appear above the Old man after you find a bag

Fixed a delay before you enter a portal

The Tentacle Monster won’t reappear after its death

Desert checkpoints fix

Other minor fixes

If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave a review and share your feedback - it means the world to our small team and helps us keep making things better.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.10
notes.content:

We'd love to hear from you about any other issues you may have in the comments to this post.

Enjoy the game!
